question: Give me the product type, name and price for all the products supplied by supplier id 3.
target_sql: SELECT T2.product_type_code ,  T2.product_name ,  T2.product_price FROM product_suppliers AS T1 JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id WHERE T1.supplier_id  =  3

question: Find the number of routes and airport name for each source airport, order the results by decreasing number of routes.
target_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  T1.name FROM airports AS T1 JOIN routes AS T2 ON T1.apid  =  T2.src_apid GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC

question: How many routes go from the United States to Canada?
target_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM routes WHERE dst_apid IN (SELECT apid FROM airports WHERE country  =  'Canada') AND src_apid IN (SELECT apid FROM airports WHERE country  =  'United States')

question: Show different tourist attractions' names, ids, and the corresponding number of visits.
target_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID ,   COUNT(*) FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN VISITS AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID  =  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID

question: Find names of instructors with salary greater than that of some (at least one) instructor in the Biology department.
target_sql: SELECT name FROM instructor WHERE salary  >  (SELECT min(salary) FROM instructor WHERE dept_name  =  'Biology')

question: What is the name of the department with the student that has the lowest GPA?
target_sql: SELECT T2.dept_name FROM student AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_code  =  T2.dept_code ORDER BY stu_gpa LIMIT 1

question: What is the title, credit value, and department name for courses with more than one prerequisite?
target_sql: SELECT T1.title ,  T1.credits , T1.dept_name FROM course AS T1 JOIN prereq AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.course_id HAVING count(*)  >  1

question: List the names of all the distinct customers who bought a keyboard.
target_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.customer_name FROM customers AS T1 JOIN customer_orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id JOIN order_items AS T3 ON T2.order_id  =  T3.order_id JOIN products AS T4 ON T3.product_id  =  T4.product_id WHERE T4.product_name  =  "keyboard"

question: Return the name and job title of the staff with the latest date assigned.
target_sql: SELECT T1.staff_name ,  T2.job_title_code FROM staff AS T1 JOIN staff_department_assignments AS T2 ON T1.staff_id  =  T2.staff_id ORDER BY T2.date_assigned_to DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the first name of students who got grade C in any class?
target_sql: SELECT DISTINCT stu_fname FROM student AS T1 JOIN enroll AS T2 ON T1.stu_num  =  T2.stu_num WHERE enroll_grade  =  'C'

question: How many different locations does each school have?
target_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT dept_address) ,  school_code FROM department GROUP BY school_code

question: What are the names and genders of staff who have held the title Sales Person, but never Clerical Staff?
target_sql: SELECT T1.staff_name ,  T1.staff_gender FROM staff AS T1 JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments AS T2 ON T1.staff_id  =  T2.staff_id WHERE T2.job_title_code  =  "Sales Person" EXCEPT SELECT T1.staff_name ,  T1.staff_gender FROM staff AS T1 JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments AS T2 ON T1.staff_id  =  T2.staff_id WHERE T2.job_title_code  =  "Clerical Staff"

question: Which city does staff with first name as Janessa and last name as Sawayn live?
target_sql: SELECT T1.city FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Staff AS T2 ON T1.address_id = T2.staff_address_id WHERE T2.first_name = "Janessa" AND T2.last_name = "Sawayn";

question: What is the average price for a lesson taught by Janessa Sawayn?
target_sql: SELECT avg(price) FROM Lessons AS T1 JOIN Staff AS T2 ON T1.staff_id = T2.staff_id WHERE T2.first_name = "Janessa" AND T2.last_name = "Sawayn";

question: What roles did staff members play between '2003-04-19 15:06:20' and '2016-03-15 00:33:18'?
target_sql: SELECT role_code FROM Project_Staff WHERE date_from  >  '2003-04-19 15:06:20' AND date_to  <  '2016-03-15 00:33:18'

question: List the names and phone numbers of all the distinct suppliers who supply red jeans.
target_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.supplier_name ,  T1.supplier_phone FROM suppliers AS T1 JOIN product_suppliers AS T2 ON T1.supplier_id  =  T2.supplier_id JOIN products AS T3 ON T2.product_id  =  T3.product_id WHERE T3.product_name  =  "red jeans"

question: What is detail of the student who most recently registered course?
target_sql: SELECT T2.student_details FROM student_course_registrations AS T1 JOIN students AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id ORDER BY T1.registration_date DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are all details of the students who registered but did not attend any course?
target_sql: SELECT * FROM student_course_registrations WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM student_course_attendance)

question: What are the price ranges of five star hotels?
target_sql: SELECT price_range FROM HOTELS WHERE star_rating_code  =  "5"

question: Find the names and average salaries of all departments whose average salary is greater than 42000.
target_sql: SELECT dept_name ,  AVG (salary) FROM instructor GROUP BY dept_name HAVING AVG (salary)  >  42000

question: List the description of the outcomes for all projects.
target_sql: SELECT T1.outcome_description FROM Research_outcomes AS T1 JOIN Project_outcomes AS T2 ON T1.outcome_code  =  T2.outcome_code

question: Find courses that ran in Fall 2009 but not in Spring 2010.
target_sql: SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester  =  'Fall' AND YEAR  =  2009 EXCEPT SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE semester  =  'Spring' AND YEAR  =  2010

question: For each project id, how many tasks are there?
target_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  T1.project_details FROM Projects AS T1 JOIN Tasks AS T2 ON T1.project_id  =  T2.project_id GROUP BY T1.project_id

question: What are the forenames and surnames of drivers who participated in the races named Australian Grand Prix but not the races named Chinese Grand Prix?
target_sql: SELECT T3.forename ,  T3.surname FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverid = T3.driverid WHERE T1.name = "Australian Grand Prix" EXCEPT SELECT T3.forename ,  T3.surname FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverid = T3.driverid WHERE T1.name = "Chinese Grand Prix"

question: List phone number and email address of customer with more than 2000 outstanding balance.
target_sql: SELECT phone_number ,  email_address FROM Customers WHERE amount_outstanding  >  2000;

question: How many orders does Luca Mancini have in his invoices?
target_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.first_name = "Lucas" AND T1.last_name = "Mancini";

question: List the number of invoices from Chicago, IL.
target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE billing_city  =  "Chicago" AND billing_state  =  "IL";

question: What are the duration of the longest and shortest pop tracks in milliseconds?
target_sql: SELECT max(Milliseconds) ,  min(Milliseconds) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId  =  T2.GenreId WHERE T1.Name  =  "Pop"

question: What are the titles of courses without prerequisites?
target_sql: SELECT title FROM course WHERE course_id NOT IN (SELECT course_id FROM prereq)

question: How many albums has Billy Cobam released?
target_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM albums AS T1 JOIN artists AS T2 ON  T1.artist_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = "Billy Cobham";
